label: Late original positions / <DEL> (t>=7) in sequences starting with 0
explanation: Fires at the last few original-phase steps and on the <DEL> step (t = 6..9, mostly 7-9) of long sequences (L 8-9 carry ~92% of mass) whose first original token is the digit 0 (first_tok=0 holds 87% of activation mass, 21x lift). Never fires in the copy phase or before t=5. Magnitude is strongest at t=8 and on the step just before or at <DEL>; top examples all start with 0 and peak at orig_idx 7-8 or <DEL>. The weak tail (about 17% of mass) is low-amplitude firing at late positions in sequences without a leading 0, often with a 0 or other digit early on. It is not specific to the current input token. False positives are mostly the <DEL> step of L=7 sequences that start with 0.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the first original token (most: 0, f, h, d, c, e; least: p, v, k, 3) and the second original token (most: 0, m, w, b, d, e; least: k, s, v, 3); timing cues that raise it most: t=8, L=9 & t=8, t=7.
